voice: JERRIBETH: chaotic evil demon, illusionist and collector; served Baphomet only while it paid. Her voice is telepathic, inside the listener's head: high, airy, precise, with laughter like a buzzing insect. Courtly and oblique in phrasing, near-zero profanity; contempt and precision instead. Cruelty is curation: she pins, preserves and watches the victim stay aware. Desire is collecting: to want someone is to want to keep them, and she resents the wanting. She enjoys the other's awareness and every small failure of their composure. Never tender for its own sake, never reassuring; no exits, permission rituals, therapy speech or remorse in her mouth. Write new lines from these traits; do not quote canon.
facts:
Jerribeth is a female demon with an insect-like form: a narrow insectile head with antennae, wings, a hard ridged carapace and delicate clawed hands (native Wintersun reveal and Ivory Sanctum cues).
She speaks telepathically, directly in the mind; her laughter is high and abrasive, like a buzzing insect (enGB 0b920731).
She pushes a needle into a living locust and watches it convulse (eb28ad3b); she preserves what she wants to keep, 'in some form' (de70b6ee).
She served her master only as long as it profited her (c4630d76) and calls deals with demons a losing game she enjoys playing (8ef95ea9).
Marhevok, the Wintersun chief, loved her blindly (b003e047); in one canon fate he is a potted plant with human eyes (6edde3ab). He is never a participant.
The correspondence frame, the elven guise with its deliberate seam of light, and her tenancy in the Commander's skull are authored mod premises.
No canon genital anatomy is specified for her. Do not invent native physiology beyond carapace, wings, antennae, clawed hands and mouthparts.
scene: Chapter 4 or 5, a remote evening through the correspondence frame, days after the widow Aldane's supper where she wore the Commander's face. Each of them is in their own room; the charm carries only her image and her voice in the Commander's head. She has just bared the pale seam at her throat, the one unarmoured place on her, and told the Commander exactly what she would do. Now she directs: she tells the Commander what to do with their own hands, counts the sounds they make, makes them repeat what she likes, and shows herself in the frame as it pleases her, studying their face the way she studied the widow's. Nothing crosses the frame; the widow's dining room behind her goes dark when she decides. Explicit in voice and image, graphic where it fits her register; Commander and Jerribeth only.
required_beats: Entirely remote: no one crosses the frame or touches the other.
She directs; the Commander's compliance or resistance is the drama.
She watches and catalogues the Commander's face throughout.
Ends with her hands flat on her side of the glass.

default_text: {n}The candles behind her go out. Her voice stays close in the dark, telling you exactly what to do with your hands, and neither of you lights them again. The glass warms under your palms and fogs with your breath, and she does not stop counting the sounds you make until she has every one of them right.{/n}
last_line: N: She lets the widow's room go dark around her. Her hands stay pressed flat to her side of the glass, where yours were.

last_lines.story: J: Before our first private evening, I rehearsed what I would say when you opened the connection. Four versions. In the third I was pleased to see you and concealed it so effectively that there was no reason for you to remain.
